text:
tanya (FinOps): Flagging Cobalt Therapeutics renewal INV-2026-402 — platform fee and support lines look duplicated due to their mid-term private migration + support band swap. Need corrected invoice before renewal outreach next week.
rao (Billing): can you paste the invoice fragment?
tanya (FinOps): PDF lines: ```INV-2026-402
Line 4: Platform Fee - 01Jan2026-31Dec2026 - $150,000
Line 9: Migration - Private Deployment (effective 01Aug2026) - Charge: $75,000
Line 15: Support Tier: Silver -> Gold swap - Period 01Aug2026-31Jul2027 - Charge: $18,000
Line 21: Support Tier: Gold - Period 01Jan2026-31Dec2026 - Charge: $36,000```
emma (CS): Customer moved to private 2026-08-01 per AMEND-24 signed 2026-07-20. Sales told CS migration should pro-rate platform fee and replace the annual support line.
marco (Sales): confirmed. Sales ops ticket SO-1584 requested proration + support band change. I approved a one-time credit path if needed.
rao (Billing): Reproduced locally. Renewals pipeline applied the annual platform fee and also added a migration charge (mapping rule for legacy contracts), doubling the effective platform amount for Aug-Dec. Also support swap created overlapping support lines. Filing billing-engine ticket.
billing-bot: Created BE-9302 "migration + support-swap generates duplicate platform/support lines on renewal" assigned to billing-engine-team. https://issues.redwood/BE-9302
tanya (FinOps): We need a manual corrected invoice & credit memo ASAP. Rough calculations: platform should be pro-rated for Aug-Dec -> 5 months. Correct platform portion = 150,000 * 5/12 = 62,500. Current net billed (150k + 75k) => 225k, so credit = 225k - 62,500 = 162,500. Support credit: remove annual Gold 36k and keep swapped Gold for Aug-Jul 18k -> support credit = 36k - 18k = 18k. Total credit ~180,500. Double-check math and include auditor note.
rao (Billing): whoa that's bigger than I expected. I'll prepare draft credit memo with line-level calc and attach AMEND-24 + SO-1584. Routing to finance lead AR-7122 for sign-off. ETA: draft by EOD, final tomorrow after approval.
emma (CS): I'll reach out to Cobalt, say we're issuing a billing correction and will share corrected invoice. Avoid the word "error" — frame as "contract alignment".
marco (Sales): I approve the credit path. Adding my sign-off to AR-7122.
billing-bot: BE-9302 update: triage done; root cause = legacy migration mapping + support-swap ordering; fix planned and backfill scheduled for next nightly run.
tanya (FinOps): please include clear pro-rate months in the credit memo (Aug-Dec = 5 months), reference AMEND-24 and SO-1584, and include the per-line arithmetic for auditors. Also request expedited posting so renewal email can go out with corrected docs.
rao (Billing): Will include those notes. Will ping once credit memo is posted and corrected invoice issued.
emma (CS): I'll hold renewal outreach until I have the updated invoice attached.
tanya (FinOps): thanks everyone — close the loop when BE-9302 backfill completes so we can confirm automation won't reoccur. :white_check_mark:
